footnote_text: The award represents a total of 160,256 restricted stock units granted under the terms of the Issuer's 2026 Inducement Stock Plan. Under the terms of the restricted stock unit grant agreement, 1/4 of the total number of units shall vest on March 15, 2027 and each six-month anniversary thereafter, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment with the Issuer on each scheduled vesting date. Each unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock upon vesting. || Shares held following the reported transactions include 160,256 shares of Class A common stock underlying restricted stock units, which are subject to forfeiture until they vest.
